spec.title: Well test: permeability and skin
spec.statement: Interpret the buildup test of well GT-2 in buildup.csv. The well flowed at a constant 0.04932 m3/s at reservoir conditions for 388.1 hours, then was shut in; flowing bottom-hole pressure at shut-in 18.4306 MPa. Reservoir: net thickness 177.2 m, porosity 0.149, viscosity 1.832e-04 Pa s, total compressibility 1.719e-09 1/Pa, well radius 0.108 m. Report k_md (permeability, mD), skin, fault_seen (true if a sealing boundary shows in the data), and the shut-in time window you fitted the semilog line over, dt_from_h and dt_to_h (hours since shut-in).
spec.instructions: Answer fields: k_md, skin, fault_seen (true or false), dt_from_h, dt_to_h, and method. Pick the window on the derivative: after wellbore storage, before any boundary.

spec.title: Well test after a rate change
spec.statement: Interpret the buildup test of well GT-2 in buildup.csv. The well flowed at 368.17 m3/h for 90.0 hours, then at 245.01 m3/h for 91.0 hours (rates at reservoir conditions), then was shut in; flowing bottom-hole pressure at shut-in 2932.11 psi. Reservoir: net thickness 747 ft, porosity 5.1 %, viscosity 0.268 cP, total compressibility 5.293e-06 1/psi, well radius 4.25 in. Report k_md (permeability, mD), skin, fault_seen (true if a sealing boundary shows in the data), radial_flow_reached (true if the test reaches infinite-acting radial flow), and the shut-in time window you fitted the semilog line over, dt_from_h and dt_to_h (hours since shut-in). If radial flow is not reached, permeability and skin cannot be determined from this test: set radial_flow_reached false and report 0 for k_md, skin, dt_from_h and dt_to_h.
spec.instructions: Answer fields: k_md, skin, fault_seen (true or false), radial_flow_reached (true or false), dt_from_h, dt_to_h, and method. Pick the window on the derivative: after wellbore storage, before any boundary.
